_classes.name: designation_no_actor gate drops real list-item duties under a 'shall have the following powers and duties' / 'responsibilities shall include' / 'shall (a)' lead-in
_classes.rule: dropped/*.json: rule=='designation_no_actor' and re.match(r'^(To [a-z]+|Advise|Work with|Serve as|Review and|Engage in|Assure|Provide|Require|Conduct|Determine|Furnish|Establish|Develop|Prepare|Maintain|[Cc]onsider|Implement|Divide|Eliminate|Identify)\b', quote) (335 designation_no_actor drops in total)

_classes.name: act_clause gate drops amended sunset sections of OTHER chapters (real extends_existing records)
_classes.rule: dropped/*.json: rule=='act_clause' and in the packet law text (deleted matter removed) the 600 chars before the quote match r'(section|subdivision|paragraph) [\w-]+ of (chapter|part) [\w-]+ of the laws of \d{4}[^.]*is (hereby )?amended'. Note: 0 of 139 act_clause drops match the law's own stored raw_clause.

_classes.name: list items under a 'shall' lead-in stored as power (powers-and-duties list, director-shall-promulgate list)
_classes.rule: kind=='power' and re.match(r'^(To )?(promulgate|furnish|conduct|determine|provide|require|establish)\b', quote, re.I); over-inclusive, true powers also match

_classes.name: one-time setup duty (rulemaking, appointment, signage installation) given deadline none instead of on_effective_date
_classes.rule: kind=='duty' and deadline_kind=='none' and ((recurrence=='one-time' and deliverable_type in ('rulemaking','designation or staffing')) or (deliverable_type=='signage or installation' and re.search('install', quote, re.I)))

_classes.name: benefit/amount sentences stored as duties (known entitlement class, recurrence)
_classes.rule: kind=='duty' and re.search(r'\b(rate|final average salary|allowances?|pensions?|interest|benefits?)\b[^.;]{0,160}\bshall be (calculated|continued|used|equal|one-half|allowed|increased|credited)', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: contents of a director's remedial directive stored with the directed agency ('said agency') as actor
silent record loss: obligation_id gaps with no stored or dropped record (parallel provision with identical quote)
_classes.rule: per matter_id, integers 1..max(obligation_id suffix) absent from both stored records and dropped/*.json
